scope: All 21 previously GT-evaluated cases, plus explicit carry-forward of 8 unsupported cases. Post-hoc exploratory extension, not independent validation. All P6-P8 rules fixed before P5 GT diagnostics.
camera_policy: provided calibrated cameras fixed; per-camera confidence is not available or tested
confidence_policy: cached VGGT-Omega depth_conf pixel score, not a calibrated probability; no GT normalization
distance_policy: estimated scaled raw camera-Z, equal-count rank thirds per view within existing plane mask; GT never defines groups
group_ties: stable sort by value then flattened pixel ID, three rank partitions; record medians and ties
raw_normal_fit: same robust weighted SVD as P2, all selected raw depth points; scale fixed to original per-case RGB FIT scale

P5_spatial_control.policy: identical per-cell counts on common occupied cells; if impossible, NOT_IDENTIFIABLE_SPATIAL_CONFOUNDING, no replacement

P6_primary: P6_NEAR; other arms fixed auxiliary comparisons, no GT-based winner selection
P7_weight: hull_fraction * median within-ROI confidence percentile / max(raw-normal spatial bootstrap angular RMS degrees,0.25)^2; sign-invariant weighted normal axis average
P7_primary: P7_NEAR versus P6_NEAR, fixed camera intrinsics/poses; this dataset supplies stereo two-view support, ETH3D five-view cases remain unsupported
P8_anchor: original all-pixel B1 raw plane direction; compare original B2 fixed and B3 free
P8_objective: unchanged FIT-only bidirectional radial Huber 1 processed pixel; SLSQP max500 ftol1e-12, positive-depth linear constraints plus analytic normal-cone constraint
P8_starts: original B3 only if already within cone
retention: If raw subset support or positive-depth gate fails, retain original B2 for P6; if fewer than two valid normals retain respective P6 for P7; if P8 solver fails retain original B2. Preserve reason, proposal and retained result; do not claim fallback is successful new estimation.
evaluation: GT after all fitting only; original P4 GT arrays/reference/bootstrap reused; per-case and per-dataset paired differences, failures and normal/depth regressions retained. ID bootstrap descriptive only; no independent scene claim.
original_frozen_parameters: Existing masks, RGB tracks, FIT/heldout split, common scale, cameras and optimizer Huber remain unchanged; no SAM/new network training/new image selection.
